messages:
Alex P: Hey team — heads up: I'm going to be unreachable for the EU overnight shift tomorrow (holiday travel). I'm the primary for 23:00-07:00 CET. I left notes in the rota but realized the secondary (Maya) is in APAC and will be asleep for most of that window. Can someone volunteer a shadow/backup? Need someone who can respond to pagers and start the bridge if needed.

Maya R: Sorry Alex — yeah I'm out for part of that block, I can cover the first 2 hours (23:00-01:00 CET) but then I have a family commitment. I can shadow until 01:00 and do a proper handoff. :wave:

Santiago L: I can take the 01:00-05:00 CET window if that helps. I'm flexible but prefer no more than 4hr continuous primary. Happy to be secondary thereafter.

Priya S: I can do 05:00-07:00 CET (morning overlap) and handle any customer follow-ups. Won't be able to stay on the bridge for >30m without heads-up.

Alex P: Thanks all. So proposed plan: Maya primary 23:00-01:00 (shadow), Santiago primary 01:00-05:00, Priya secondary 05:00-07:00. We still need a short-notice backup for the 23:00-01:00 slot in case Maya drops. Any volunteers for a 23:30->handshake window?

IncidentBot: Pager triggered: svc-ingest - error rate spike >5% (15m rolling) in eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Pager rule: oncall-primary. Link: https://alerts.redwood/sys/pagers/9271

Maya R: Oh crap seeing the bot. I'm awake — taking it now. On the bridge?

Alex P: I'm away but gave perms — grab the bridge. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/svc-ingest-err-spike. Key checks:
```
1) Check CPU/GPU saturation on serving node pool: curl -s https://infra.redwood/api/nodes?pool=ingest-eu | jq '.nodes[].util'
2) Check batch queue length: REDWOOD_METRICS:ingest.batch_queue{region="eu-west-1"}
3) Check KV cache hit ratio: redis-cli -h ingest-cache.metrics GET hit_ratio
4) If error rate >10% AND latency >1s, start bridge and escalate to infra oncall.
```

Maya R: On bridge now -> zoom.us/j/123456789. Quick check: CPU spike on ingest-redis-3, some 5xx from model instance mk-v2-03. I'll tail logs.

Santiago L: I'm in eu-west-1, can jump to SSH if needed. If mk-v2-03 is flapping maybe a graceful restart + rotate. Keep telemetry links handy: https://observability.redwood/dashboards/ingest-overview

OpsBot: Uptime SLA check: 00:00-07:00 CET window has 3 customers with scheduled fin-cron jobs. If outage persists >15m, notify account-ops@redwood.com

Maya R: Found repeated 'OOM when allocating KV cache' in mk-v2-03 logs. Evicted a few pods, we're seeing tail latency down but error rate still ~4%. Scaling policy attempted autoscale +1, no new pods coming up (quota?).

Santiago L: Trying to provision a spare in eu-west-1: `kubectl apply -f mk-v2-spare.yaml --namespace=prod` — hitting quota error: "Insufficient GPUs in region". I'll attempt cross-zone fallback to eu-central-1 and route traffic.

Alex P: Important: if we need to fallback region, update smart-routing policy to route eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 for model mk-v2-v0.2. Use policy id: routing-eu-fallback-42. Make sure to set max_latency_degradation 300ms.

Priya S: Customer impact: first noticed by partner-integrations in EU — some 5xx on batch ingest. I've pinged account-ops on slack and sent a short status to affected customers (templated). Will update if they escalate.

IncidentBot: Pager resolved for svc-ingest (error rate below threshold). Closing tentative: false.

Maya R: Thanks everyone — looks like eviction + short-term prefix cache flush did the trick. I'm going to stay on the bridge for 10 more minutes while metrics stabilize. Plan for overnight coverage: I can stay until 01:00, then handoff to Santiago. Alex, since you're offline, leaving a TODO to confirm the rota update.

Santiago L: I'll be primary at 01:00. Quick handoff checklist I need: active bridge URL, current incident playbook state, any temporary routing/policy changes, list of affected customers. Can someone paste before I take over?

Maya R: Bridge: zoom.us/j/123456789. Playbook state: 'mitigated' (eviction + cache flush; autoscale failing due to region GPU quota). Routing: no policy changes applied. Affected customers: partner-integ-A, partner-integ-B (low volume). Logs: /var/logs/ingest/mk-v2-03.log (OOM traces until 23:45).

Priya S: I've added a note in the incident ticket with customer messages and contact points. Also scheduled a follow-up with infra tomorrow 09:00 CET to request quota increase or pre-provision spares.

Alex P: Appreciate the run-through. Two operational notes before I drop: (1) If error resurfacing and we can't provision additional GPUs, enable degraded-mode routing (read-only or smaller batch sizes) with flag `DEGRADED_BATCH=1` in routing-eu-fallback-42. (2) If latency >1.5s and customer impact >10%, escalate to SE-VP and open high-urgency incident channel.

Santiago L: Got it. I'll monitor until 05:00 but would like someone to hand me off at 03:00 for a short break if needed (15-20m). Priya, can you be reachable for the 03:00-03:30 shadow?

Priya S: I can be on-call for that mini-handshake. Set a reminder for 02:50 CET.

Maya R: Leaving bridge in 5 — Santiago you should have everything. Alex: enjoy your travel.

Santiago L: Thanks — taking over as primary now. Setting myself oncall-primary in rota. Starting 01:00-05:00 CET window. Will post any changes here.

IncidentBot: Note: oncall-primary set to Santiago L for 01:00-05:00 CET.

Priya S: Confirmed reminder set. If anything critical happens ping me directly @Priya S or call mobile. :phone:

Alex P: Thanks team. Leaving one more pointer in the rota: add a spare volunteer rule for holiday coverage — we should avoid single-person gaps next time. I'll create a follow-up ticket in the rota-project.

Santiago L: Copy. Monitoring + will escalate if it comes back up.
